_meta.description: Map-valued crosstab cells: region (rows) × age-decile (columns) with AGG_SET_FREQUENCY as the cell aggregator. Each cell carries a {label: count} map of credit-card issuer occurrences within that region/age bucket. Exercises the MatrixCell.Value=any contract and the RichAggregator dispatch path — normalize must stay 'none' because per-bit maps cannot be normalized as scalars.
_meta.name: crosstab_set_frequency_map_cells
